name: prims_ts_decode_mla_wrapper_causal_maxq4_maxk2048_h128_d_qk576_ckv512_kpe64_ps32_sq4
description: Reusable PrimTS MLA decode wrapper. The plan fixes masks, static bounds, and exact batch size. Every run supplies page tables and sequence lengths; packed-Q runs also supply Q offsets.

batch_size.description: Exact number of planned MLA requests.

causal.description: One for a causal plan and zero for a dense plan.

kv_lora_rank.description: Latent K/V rank frozen by plan().

qk_rope_head_dim.description: RoPE head dimension frozen by plan().

block_tables.description: Required physical page table supplied to run().

seq_lens.description: Required per-request KV lengths supplied to run().

qo_indptr.description: Cumulative Q offsets required by a packed-Q run.

validate.description: Whether to validate per-run tensors and metadata values.

check:
def standard_check(
    reference_outputs: Any,
    actual_outputs: Any,
    *,
    rtol: Optional[float] = None,
    atol: Optional[float] = None,
    max_mismatch_pct: float = 0.0,
    min_cos_sim: Optional[float] = 1.0 - 1e-3,
) -> bool:
    """Default trace correctness check used when a template does not override it."""
    from flashinfer.trace import default_check

    return default_check(
        reference_outputs,
        actual_outputs,
        rtol=rtol,
        atol=atol,
        max_mismatch_pct=max_mismatch_pct,
        min_cos_sim=min_cos_sim,
    )
